errors.startup_failed: Harness failed during {{phase}}. Last readiness status: {{reason}}
errors.startup_inactivity: Harness made no progress during {{phase}} before its activity deadline. Last readiness status: {{reason}}
errors.startup_absolute: Harness exceeded the maximum allowed time for {{phase}}. Last readiness status: {{reason}}
errors.startup_exited: Harness exited during {{phase}}. Last readiness status: {{reason}}
errors.process_exited_with_code: Harness stopped unexpectedly (exit code {{code}}). Restart to continue.
errors.process_exited_native_crash: The Harness process was killed by the system (exit code {{code}}, a native Windows crash). This is not a heap exhaustion: no JavaScript exception will appear in the log. A graphics driver or a native module is the usual cause. Restart to continue.
errors.process_exited_without_code: Harness stopped unexpectedly. Restart to continue.
errors.client_boot_stalled: The client remained on Loading plugins after all bounded reload attempts.
errors.client_boot_failed: The client reported a failure while loading plugins.
errors.plugin_route_conflict: Detected a plugin route conflict: two plugins registered the same route twice. Uninstall the recently added plugin (e.g. dsh-web-ui-all / dsh-better-sidebar) from the Plugins panel, or run dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove <package> for the active profile and retry.
errors.inotify_limit: The Harness service crashed on startup: your system reached the limit for file watchers (inotify ENOSPC). Increase the watcher limit and restart — e.g. run `sudo sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches=524288` (and add `fs.inotify.max_user_watches=524288` to `/etc/sysctl.conf` to persist), then restart the app.
errors.heap_oom: The Harness service was killed after running out of memory (V8 heap limit): with many concurrent sessions or subagents the service grows past the current limit and the whole session crashes. The limit in effect was {{limit}} MB. Set a larger value in Settings → Service memory limit (1024–32768), save and restart the service; closing idle sessions or reducing concurrent subagents also helps.
errors.heap_oom_unknown: The Harness service was killed after running out of memory (V8 heap limit): with many concurrent sessions or subagents the service grows past the current limit and the whole session crashes. Set a larger value in Settings → Service memory limit (1024–32768), save and restart the service; closing idle sessions or reducing concurrent subagents also helps.
errors.heap_oom_peak: The log shows {{peak}} MB of committed heap at the moment of the crash.
errors.patch_entry_unresolved: A patch layer references a plugin package that cannot be resolved, so Harness cannot load the plugin tree: {{detail}}. This usually means a plugin was uninstalled while the hand-written insert entry stayed in cordis.patch.yml. Remove those entries (or reinstall the plugin) and retry, or use "Remove dangling entries" to strip only the unresolvable entries (the original file is backed up as `.bak-<timestamp>` first).
errors.patch_entry_unresolved_declared: (still declared in package.json — reinstalling that plugin is the fix)
errors.patch_layer_parse_failed: A patch layer has a YAML syntax error, so Harness cannot parse it: {{detail}}. The usual cause is an unquoted `!!js` expression that contains `:` or `?` — quote it (`!!js "…"`) or use a block scalar (`|-`), then retry. You can also use "Quarantine broken patch files" to start anyway; that file is renamed to a `.broken-<timestamp>` backup and restored by renaming it back.
errors.patch_quarantine_failed: Could not quarantine the broken patch file (rename failed): {{detail}}. The file is still in place, so restarting will hit the same parse error. Close whatever is holding the file (editor / sync client / antivirus), or rename it to a `.broken-<timestamp>` backup manually, then retry.

ui.iframe_unreachable_hint: The service itself is running, but the embedded page never loaded. This is usually a system proxy or security tool blocking the request, or the page being redirected to an address that cannot be reached. Check your network/proxy settings, then retry.
patch.entries_stripped_toast: Removed {{count}} unresolvable patch entries; the original file was backed up as {{backup}}.
patch.quarantined_toast: Quarantined an unparsable patch file: {{original}} → {{backup}}. Fix the syntax and rename it back to restore it.
patch.quarantine_failed_toast: Failed to quarantine a broken patch file: {{path}} ({{error}})
hints.safe_mode: Restart with only the core bundles and built-in plugins, uninstalling any other plugin from that profile to isolate the ones that fail to start. Patch files that cannot be parsed (a YAML syntax error) are also moved aside as `.broken-<timestamp>` backups. Switch back to your profile in the sidebar to exit safe mode.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.tooltip: Profiles are isolated bundles of plugins, patches and settings in dsh. The desktop runs in the default web profile; create new profiles to trial different plugin combinations without affecting the current setup.
profiles.activate_confirm_desc: Switch to the {{name}} profile? Its plugins and settings will be used from now on.
profiles.activate_restart_hint: Takes effect after the service restarts. Restart now?
profiles.name_invalid_hint: Profile names accept letters, digits, "-" and "_" only — non-Latin characters are dropped, try an English or pinyin name
profiles.error_name_too_long: The profile name is too long — 64 characters at most
profiles.error_reserved: That name is reserved by the system, pick another one
profiles.error_not_found: The profile to clone no longer exists
profiles.remove_confirm_desc: Delete {{name}} permanently? Its plugins and settings will be removed. This cannot be undone.
profiles.reset_confirm_desc: Reset {{name}}? Its plugins, patches, and settings will be cleared and returned to their initial state. Sessions are not affected. This cannot be undone.
profiles.clone_dialog_desc: Create a full, independent copy of "{{name}}". The cloned profile is separate from the source.
profiles.clone_success_hint: The new profile is in the list — switch to it anytime.
profiles.migrate_desc: Merge the plugins and profile data of the source profile into the active profile. The source profile is left untouched, and on conflicts the active profile always wins.
profiles.migrate_no_source: No other profile to migrate from
profiles.migrate_plugins_empty: This profile has no plugins to migrate
profiles.migrate_nothing: The active profile already contains everything from the source profile
profiles.migrate_analyze_failed: Failed to read the source profile — nothing to migrate
profiles.migrate_partial: Some profile data was not migrated
backup.credentials_warning: Your API keys will be stored in the backup file. Keep it secure.
backup.empty_desc: Create a profile backup to protect the active profile configuration. Profile backups do not include conversations; use a recovery export below for conversations and shared data.
backup.restore_confirm_desc: Restore from {{timestamp}}? Your current profile data will be replaced. The Harness service will stop during restore.
backup.restore_new_confirm_desc: Create a new profile from the {{timestamp}} backup? Your current profile will not be changed.
backup.delete_confirm_desc: Delete the backup from {{timestamp}}? This cannot be undone.
backup.restored_toast: Backup restored — restart the service to continue

plugins.abnormal_tooltip: This plugin is running abnormally. Click to view details.
plugins.abnormal_desc: Plugin {{name}} is abnormal and may be corrupted or incompatible with the current environment.
plugins.remove_confirm_desc: Uninstall {{name}}? Its features will no longer be available after removal.
plugins.blocked_incompatible_title: {{name}} is incompatible with the current core
plugins.blocked_incompatible_desc: Rejected version: {{blocked}} (running it may crash or lose data). Authorising records the exemption and retries.
plugins.blocked_policy_title: {{name}}'s update is blocked by the release-age window
plugins.blocked_policy_desc: Blocked version: {{blocked}} (published under 24 hours ago, so pnpm skips it). Authorising records the exemption and retries.
plugins.hold_desc: {{blocked}} is still inside the release-age window (pnpm skips it). Authorising records the exemption and retries.
plugins.hold_pinned_desc: Authorised and explicitly reinstalled, but the profile still pins this plugin's source (catalog / git / link or an exact spec), so pnpm keeps the current version. The plugin itself is fine.
plugins.hold_no_target: No installable target version: the plugin's source is pinned, or npm reports no newer release. Reopen the panel to refresh the version list and try again.
plugins.disable_builtin_confirm_desc: Disabling the built-in plugin {{name}} may cause the desktop shell or related features to malfunction. Confirm disabling?
plugins.enable_override_confirm_desc: {{name}} is disabled in cordis.patch.yml. Enabling will remove only that disable override (other config entries are kept) and restart the service. Continue?
plugins.snapshot_overwrite_desc: A snapshot of {{name}} already exists. Overwrite it with the current version?
plugins.restore_confirm_desc: Restore {{name}} from its snapshot? Its current state will be replaced, and the Harness service will stop during restore.
plugins.restore_restart_hint: Plugin {{name}} restored — restart the service to continue
plugins.snapshot_delete_desc: Delete the snapshot of {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
plugins.retry_exhausted: Gave up after too many authorisation attempts
plugins.install_placeholder: Enter a plugin package or spec (comma-separated for multiple)

core.title: Harness Core
core.refresh_failed: Failed to refresh the core list
core.tooltip: Harness Core is the dsh engine powering the desktop. Manage local copies of each version here — switch the running version, or uninstall ones you no longer need.
core.switch_confirm_desc: Switch to the {{version}} version? The running engine will change to this copy.
core.recommended_warning_desc: The current recommended version is “{{version}}”. Switching to this version may cause software errors. Continue switching?
core.above_rc2_warning_desc: Versions above {{version}} contain breaking changes that may cause third-party plugin errors. Confirm the update? You can switch back to {{version}} in the core at any time.
core.remove_confirm_desc: Uninstall {{version}}? The engine copy will be removed from this device (other copies are unaffected).
core.orphaned_title: Local packages no longer in the repository
core.update_failed: Failed to update the local core
core.download_failed: Failed to download the core version
core.remove_failed: Failed to uninstall the core version
core.local_missing_hint: No local core detected. Install @deepseek-ai/dsh globally via npm/pnpm and the desktop will prefer it automatically.
core.local_unsupported_hint: Built-in plugins need dsh {{version}} or newer, so the bundled core is used instead. Update the local core before switching back to it.
core.breaking_desc: {{from}} → {{to}} switches core versions (upgrade or downgrade). Mixing them is incompatible: a newer profile on an older core can fail startup when core bundles are unavailable, and an older profile on a newer core leaves packages that break plugins and settings. Switch to a matching profile.
core.breaking_profile_failed: Failed to switch profile — the core was not switched
data_dir.description: The data directory holds sessions, attachments and plugin caches. It can be moved to another drive, and changed again at any time.
data_dir.debug_hint: Development builds always use ~/.dsh.dev and ignore DSH_HOME, so the data directory cannot be migrated here.
data_dir.unsupported: This platform does not support migrating the data directory.
data_dir.migrate_desc: Copies everything to the new location, verifies the copy, renames the old directory as a fallback and only then rewrites the environment variable. Nothing is ever deleted. Terminals that are already open must be reopened to pick up the new variable.
data_dir.leaf_placeholder: Keep the current name when empty
data_dir.leaf_invalid: Use only letters, digits, spaces and . _ -
data_dir.plan_remembered: This is where the data lived before the last migration
data_dir.plan_parent_missing: The parent folder does not exist yet and will be created
data_dir.plan_no_space: Not enough free space on the target drive
data_dir.usage_desc: Top-level folders of the current data directory, largest first.
data_dir.entries_empty_desc: The data directory is empty, or it cannot be read right now.
data_dir.rollback_title: Roll back to the old location
data_dir.rollback_desc: The old directory is still there and can be moved back as it was. The current directory is never deleted, only set aside.
data_dir.backup_no_sessions: This backup holds no sessions — the session list may be empty after rolling back
data_dir.migrate_confirm_desc: Copy {{source}} to {{target}}. The old directory is kept as .moved-timestamp. DSH will be stopped during the migration.
data_dir.migrate_done_toast: Migrated to {{target}}; the old directory is kept at {{movedTo}}
data_dir.rollback_confirm_desc: Move {{backup}} back to its original place. If the current directory {{current}} is not empty it is renamed and kept. DSH will be stopped during the rollback.
data_dir.rollback_done_toast: Rolled back to {{target}}; the current directory is kept at {{movedTo}}

recovery.reason.slot_conflict.detail: UI slot {{detail}} has duplicate registrations from conflicting plugins.
recovery.reason.load_failed.title: The plugin code could not be loaded
recovery.reason.load_failed.detail: Its files may be damaged, missing a dependency, or incompatible with this Harness version.
recovery.reason.runtime.title: A plugin is running abnormally
recovery.reason.runtime.detail: The plugin reported a runtime error. Removing it and continuing may resolve the issue.
recovery.reason.unknown.title: A plugin failed during startup
recovery.reason.unknown.detail: Harness reported an error while loading a plugin, but the exact cause could not be determined automatically.
backup.profile_scope: Profile backups include only the active profile configuration. They do not include conversations or shared workspace data and are stored inside DSH_HOME.
backup.recovery_desc: Manually export sessions, shared storage and all profiles outside DSH_HOME, under the desktop application data folder. Dependencies and existing backup archives are excluded. Linked files or folders cause the export to fail rather than silently omit their data. Exports are not automatically deleted. Other configuration files may contain secrets even when credentials are excluded.
backup.recovery_confirm_title: Stop the service and export data?
backup.recovery_confirm_desc: Finish active work and close other DSH desktop, CLI and web clients first. This desktop’s service will stop and remain stopped after the export. The export includes all profiles and conversations. To recover, extract it into an empty directory and follow README.txt; the profile Restore buttons cannot restore this archive.
backup.recovery_created: Recovery archive saved. The service remains stopped; restart it when ready.

appearance.description: Device-local desktop colours, text scale, and layout. These settings are not synced to other Harness clients.
appearance.zoom_description: Adjust text and controls on this device without changing the server or phone display.
appearance.terminal_description: Hide the sidebar while keeping the original fonts. Use the top-left sidebar button to reveal it.
appearance.transparency_description: Make the window background translucent so the desktop colours show through.
appearance.opacity_description: Text and menus stay opaque. Desktop transparency depends on your window system.
appearance.blur_description: Use the system backdrop effect on Windows and macOS. Linux support depends on the compositor.
appearance.restart: Quit Harness completely and reopen it to change the native transparency mode. Closing to the tray does not restart the app.
task_manager.description: Local app and its child processes · Refreshes every 2 seconds
task_manager.metrics_hint: Only Harness child processes can be ended. CPU uses 100% per core; memory is resident memory for listed processes. System-managed WebView processes may not appear.
task_manager.end_description: Ending {{name}} (PID {{pid}}) may interrupt its running task.
task_manager.restart_description: This interrupts local running tasks and reconnects the Harness service.
task_manager.logs_failed: Failed to read run logs. Close and reopen logs to retry.
network.description: Use a proxy for desktop downloads, update checks, plugin metadata and the Harness and plugin child processes. Leave empty to use the system or environment proxy. Desktop requests and plugin installs apply immediately; the Harness service process applies it on its next start. Retry a failed download after saving.
network.formats: Supports HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 and SOCKS5H. SOCKS5H resolves destination names through the proxy. Local connections stay direct. A SOCKS proxy also applies to desktop requests and to child processes such as curl, git and pnpm; network requests inside the Harness stay direct.
network.invalid: Enter a valid proxy URL without a path, query or fragment.
network.test_hint: Reaches the update source through the saved proxy. Unsaved edits are saved first.
network.test_timeout: No response from the proxy: the request timed out
network.test_connect: Could not connect to the proxy. Check the address and port.
network.test_status: Proxy reachable, but the update source returned {{status}}
